## Architecture Impact

### Components Affected
- [ ] Game Engine (`src/engines/`)
- [ ] Hooks (`src/hooks/`)
- [ ] Components (`src/components/`)
- [ ] Services (`src/services/`)
- [ ] Types/Interfaces (`src/interfaces/`, `src/types/`)

### SOLID Principles Checklist
- [ ] Single Responsibility: Feature has clear, focused purpose
- [ ] Open/Closed: Extends behavior without modifying existing code
- [ ] Liskov Substitution: Any new interfaces maintain substitutability
- [ ] Interface Segregation: New interfaces are minimal and focused
- [ ] Dependency Inversion: Dependencies are on abstractions

### DRY Checklist
- [ ] No duplicated logic from existing code
- [ ] Reuses existing utilities where applicable
- [ ] New utilities are generic enough for reuse
